notes: Pay for the TTC with a PRESTO or contactless card. The UP Express to Pearson takes 25 minutes. For Niagara, take the GO train (direct in summer) or a tour.
Winter brings -10°C and snow. Use the PATH underground walkway network (30 km), the Nathan Phillips ice rink and the Distillery Christmas market (November to December). Niagara's falls partly freeze.
CityPASS costs 130 CAD for 5 attractions. Museums cost 25-30 CAD and the CN Tower 45 CAD. Tax (13%) is not included in prices, and tips are 18-20%.
St. Lawrence Market is closed on Mondays. Kensington is pedestrian-only on Sundays.
Try poutine, peameal bacon sandwiches and butter tarts. The cuisine is multicultural (Chinatown, Little Italy, Greektown).
The islands ferry gets very busy in summer. Book timed tickets online.

transit.name: PRESTO Card
transit.why_chosen: Valid on the TTC subway, streetcars and buses, and on GO trains. A contactless bank card works too.

stops.name: CN Tower
stops.tips: A 553 m tower with a glass floor and the LookOut. Book online (~45 CAD) and arrive at opening to skip the queue. EdgeWalk costs extra.

stops.name: Ripley's Aquarium of Canada
stops.tips: A shark tunnel at the foot of the tower. Included with CityPASS.

stops.name: St. Lawrence Market
stops.tips: A market since 1803. Try the peameal bacon sandwich at Carousel Bakery. Closed Mondays.

stops.name: Distillery District
stops.tips: A Victorian whisky distillery turned quarter: galleries, Soma chocolate and a Christmas market in December.

stops.name: Harbourfront Centre
stops.tips: A lakeside walk with canoes. Look out to the islands at sunset.

backups.name: Cluny Bistro Distillery
backups.tips: A French bistro in the Distillery District.

backups.name: Hockey Hall of Fame
backups.tips: Home of the Stanley Cup. An alternative to the aquarium.

stops.name: Jack Layton Ferry Terminal
stops.tips: The Centre Island ferry takes 15 minutes (~9 CAD return). Buy tickets online.

stops.name: Centre Island
stops.tips: Rent a bike, visit the Centreville amusement park and enjoy the skyline views.

stops.name: Ward's Island Beach
stops.tips: A winter walk with views of the icy lake.

stops.name: The Riviera Ward's Island
stops.tips: An island café. Have lunch with a view of the lake.

stops.name: Hanlan's Point Sunset
stops.tips: The western tip of the island: sunset and planes from the airport. Catch the 19:00 ferry.

backups.name: Toronto Island BBQ & Beer Co
backups.tips: A garden venue on Centre Island.

backups.name: Gibraltar Point Lighthouse
backups.tips: An 1808 lighthouse said to be haunted. An alternative to the sunset.

stops.name: Kensington Market
stops.tips: Vintage shops, Latin markets and graffiti. Car-free on Sundays (May to October).

stops.name: Chinatown Spadina
stops.tips: One of Canada's largest Chinatowns. Come for dim sum.

stops.name: Rol San Chinatown
stops.tips: A dim sum classic. Open 24 hours.

stops.name: Art Gallery of Ontario
stops.tips: Gehry's wooden spiral staircase, plus the Group of Seven and Rubens. Free on Wednesday evenings.

stops.name: Graffiti Alley
stops.tips: Street art along Rush Lane in Queen West.

backups.name: Seven Lives Tacos Kensington
backups.tips: Baja fish tacos. Expect a queue.

backups.name: Bata Shoe Museum
backups.tips: A shoe museum. An alternative to the AGO.

stops.name: Royal Ontario Museum
stops.tips: Dinosaurs and Libeskind's crystal extension. Discounted on Tuesday evenings.

stops.name: Yorkville
stops.tips: An upmarket neighbourhood with shops along Bloor Street.

stops.name: Sassafraz Yorkville
stops.tips: Yorkville's brunch classic in a yellow house.

stops.name: Casa Loma
stops.tips: A Gothic castle with a secret tunnel and a tower. The gardens are open May to October.

stops.name: Spadina Museum
stops.tips: An Edwardian-era house next to Casa Loma.

backups.name: Gardiner Museum
backups.tips: A ceramics museum opposite the ROM.

stops.name: Niagara Falls Table Rock
stops.tips: Take the GO train and bus (2 hours) or a tour (~90 CAD). Stand at the foot of Horseshoe Falls. Free.

stops.name: Niagara City Cruises Hornblower
stops.tips: In winter the boat does not run, but you can take the Journey Behind the Falls tunnel (25 CAD).

stops.name: Niagara Parkway Walk
stops.tips: A riverside park. The Clifton Hill amusement area is touristy.

stops.name: Table Rock Market Lunch
stops.tips: A dining floor with views of the falls.

stops.name: Niagara-on-the-Lake
stops.tips: A Victorian town among vineyards. Try icewine tastings (Inniskillin). Take the WEGO bus.

backups.name: Inniskillin Winery
backups.tips: Icewine tasting. An alternative to the town.

backups.name: Skylon Tower
backups.tips: A tower overlooking the falls. Go if the boat is closed.

stops.name: The Beaches Boardwalk
stops.tips: A winter walk by the shore, with snow and the lake.

stops.name: Queen Street East Beaches
stops.tips: Neighbourhood shops and cafés.

stops.name: Lady Marmalade Leslieville
stops.tips: Brunch in Leslieville. Expect a queue.

stops.name: Evergreen Brick Works
stops.tips: A park and Saturday market in a former brick factory. Walk into the Don Valley.

stops.name: Riverdale Park East Lookout
stops.tips: The best free sunset view of the city skyline.

backups.name: Tommy Thompson Park
backups.tips: An artificial peninsula in the lake with birdlife. An alternative to Brick Works.

stops.name: Trinity Bellwoods Park
stops.tips: A hipster park with white squirrels.

stops.name: Queen Street West
stops.tips: Boutiques near MOCA, plus Ossington.

stops.name: Aunties and Uncles
stops.tips: A classic brunch diner for a farewell meal.

stops.name: Union Station UP Express
stops.tips: The UP Express to Pearson takes 25 minutes. Time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Museum of Contemporary Art Toronto
backups.tips: Contemporary art in the Junction. An alternative to Queen West.
